afterFinish.instruction: Do not wait until the end of the epic. Record the settled decision with remember_note, then immediately run /issue-review (start_agent_run with agent "issue-review" for the repository) to close the completed decision issue (keeping any parent epic open) and reconcile duplicates/labels, or run /project-manager (start_agent_run with agent "project-manager") if the decision changes story criteria, scope, or backlog items (listing the decision issue in closedIssues).

steps.name: Descobrir
steps.task: Read the documentation and the code to learn the architecture really in use. Write no code.

steps.name: Analisar
steps.task: List structural flaws and deviations from the documented conventions, with their risk and impact.

steps.name: Desenhar
steps.task: Design the solution: contracts, module boundaries, layers and data flow.

steps.name: Briefing
steps.task: Write the execution prompt for the executing agent: files with exact paths, contracts, signatures, acceptance criteria and test plan.
